title: Gate operations in the layered circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a DAG circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates have distinct arguments and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. Every gate operation in the associated layered circuit is either the identity, the NOT operation, or an unbounded fan-in AND operation.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
